description: This file defines the CallsignTLS class and related constructs for managing thread-local callsign information, including guards and accessors, within the Thunder project.

classes.name: CallsignTLS
classes.description: Manages thread-local callsign data with thread safety and access control.

classes.name: CallSignTLSGuard
classes.description: RAII guard class that sets and resets the callsign within a scope.

classes.name: CallsignAccess
classes.description: Template struct providing access to the callsign with module name caching.

methods.name: Name()
methods.description: Returns the internal name string or nullptr if empty.
